samples.privateBody: Grab, chip and channel sample sheets are shared with buyers and investors on request.

method.title: How the samples were taken.
method.body: Geologists cut channel samples along painted lines across the ore face, took chip and grab samples from outcrops and boulders, and bagged and labelled each sample for laboratory analysis. Sample lengths are recorded so that section grades can be length-weighted.
